text: So [[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]] was very poor, and he had many children as well.
He had many children and he didn't have much money, so they lived a poor life. So the Prophet ﷺ lived a poor life with him as well.
And the Prophet ﷺ actually helped the household, helped the household of [[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]] in terms of earning money.

So when the Prophet ﷺ was able to, he would actually take some of the sheep from the people of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] and he would actually tend to those sheep and herd those sheep on the outskirts of [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] to earn some money to help [[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]] take care of the household.
